correction.name: thompson_microphysics_cloud_pathway
correction.rationale: The common-grid assessment finds a persistent negative cloud and rain anomaly from 03:00 UTC, before the land-state divergence threshold. The correction therefore changes the hydrometeor conversion pathway only.

frozen_controls: REA-L forcing publication and all forcing variables
REA-L initialized static domain and land model
YSU, surface, wind solver, terrain, vertical grid, time step, and output cadence
validation_sequence: common-grid causal assessor with the same contract and reference
only if the 24-hour correction reduces the leading cloud/rain deficit without an engineering or physical failure: frozen 72-hour summer gate
